item.text: I’m checking Mistral’s current API reference and SDK type definitions to reconcile the documentation example with the checker’s narrower union.

item.query: site:docs.mistral.ai files upload purpose ocr fine-tune batch ...

queries: site:docs.mistral.ai files upload purpose ocr fine-tune batch

item.text:
The `/v1/files` upload endpoint accepts these `purpose` values:

- `fine-tune`
- `batch`
- `ocr`

So `purpose="ocr"` is valid at the API level. Your type checker is using an outdated or lagging SDK type definition whose union only includes `fine-tune` and `batch`. Upgrade the Mistral SDK if possible; otherwise, use a narrowly scoped type override.

The current API reference lists the same three values for both the upload request and file response: [Mistral Files API](https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/files).
